About Cynthia L. Haven

Cynthia L. Haven is a National Endowment for the Humanities Public Scholar. She has written regularly for The Times Literary Supplement , and has also contributed to The New York Times Book Review, The Nation, The Wall Street Journal, The Virginia Quarterly Review, The Washington Post, The Los Angeles Times, The San Francisco Chronicle, The Los Angeles Review of Books, and World Literature Today . Her work has also appeared in Le Monde, La Repubblica, Die Welt, Zvezda, Colta, Zeszyty Literackie, The Kenyon Review, Quarterly Conversation, The Georgia Review, and Civilization .
Her Evolution of Desire: A Life of René Girard (2018), the first biography of the French theorist,was praised in the The New York Review of Books , The Times Literary Supplement , The Wall Street Journal , The San Francisco Chronicle , and the Philadelphia Inquirer , among others. It was named one of the top books of 2018 by The San Francisco Chronicle. She is the editor of René Girard’s All Desire is a Desire for Being: Essential Writings , published in 2023 by Penguin Classics.
